pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: better-sqlite3 is deliberately absent. It has a binding.gyp but no install script, so allowlisting it makes pnpm default to `node-gyp rebuild` — which compiles from source and needs a full toolchain (this is what broke the Windows CI runner: no Visual Studio). It ships N-API prebuilds for darwin/linux/win32 x64+arm64, and N-API is ABI-stable across both Node and Electron, so the prebuild is all we need. Verified: with every compiled artifact deleted, the Electron app boots and runs its migrations on the prebuild alone.
